home.title: Premium flooring and acoustic panels for Quebec professionals

legal.draftNotice: Draft version. Terroa must complete this text and have it reviewed by legal counsel before launch. Values in square brackets are still to be supplied.
legal.privacyLead: What Terroa collects, why, who can see it and how long it is kept.
legal.p1Text: Person in charge of personal information: [name, email]. Company: [Legal name].
legal.p2Text: Quote request: name and email (required); phone, company and role (optional); site city, project type and notes. We do not ask for the site street address. Uploaded plan: the file and the rooms read from it; a plan can contain names or addresses. Security: IP address and browser type, to limit abuse.
legal.p3Text: To prepare and follow up your quote, and to measure the areas on your plan. Email news is sent only with your consent, given separately and unchecked by default.
legal.p4Text: Terroa’s sales team, and the providers that host the site, the database and email: [providers and locations to confirm]. The plan reader sends your plan to an artificial intelligence service located outside Quebec: [provider and location to confirm].
legal.p5Text: Quote requests: [period]. Uploaded plans: deleted after [N] days, or immediately if you select “Delete plan”.
legal.p6Text: You can ask to access, correct or delete your information, or withdraw a consent, by writing to [name, email]. We reply within 30 days.
legal.p7Text: The site uses no tracking cookies and no advertising pixels. Your current quote is kept in your browser’s local storage; you can clear it at any time.
legal.termsLead: Rules for using the site and its calculation tools.
legal.t2Text: A request is not an order. No payment is made online. Prices, taxes (GST and QST) and delivery are set out in Terroa’s quote.
legal.t3Text: Quantities are estimates. Dimensions read from a plan are not measured on site: check them before ordering. [Additional text to be supplied by Terroa.]
